import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u068/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    return [[background] * len(grid[0])] + [row[:] for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
p=programs/'task-ec7bf0ca.py'
p.write_text(code)
